slides.content:
# Best, Average, Worst Case ⏱️

## Example: Linear Search

```python
def find(arr, target):
    for i, val in enumerate(arr):
        if val == target:
            return i
    return -1
```

| Case | When | Complexity |
|------|------|------------|
| Best | First element | O(1) |
| Average | Middle | O(n/2) = O(n) |
| Worst | Last or not found | O(n) |

> 💡 **We usually analyze worst case** for guarantees!

slides.title: Profiling Code
slides.content:
# Performance Profiling 🔬

## Time Measurement

```python
import time

start = time.time()
# Your code here
end = time.time()
print(f"Time: {end - start:.4f}s")
```

## cProfile

```python
import cProfile

cProfile.run('your_function()')
```

## timeit

```python
import timeit

time = timeit.timeit(
    'sum(range(1000))',
    number=10000
)
print(f"Average: {time/10000:.6f}s")
```

slides.title: Optimization Tips
slides.content:
# Optimization Techniques ⚡

## Use Built-ins

```python
# Slow
result = 0
for x in nums:
    result += x

# Fast
result = sum(nums)
```

## List Comprehensions

```python
# Slower
squares = []
for x in range(1000):
    squares.append(x**2)

# Faster
squares = [x**2 for x in range(1000)]
```

## Generators for Large Data

```python
# Memory heavy
data = [x**2 for x in range(10_000_000)]

# Memory efficient
data = (x**2 for x in range(10_000_000))
```
